sketch:
Observe: SVG 3D-ish isometric with a particle velocity v, field B,
and computed F = q·v ∧ B arrow shown by right-hand rule. Student
rotates v around; F stays perpendicular to both, magnitude qvB·sin(θ).
Experiment: 3 seeded (v, B) pairs; student picks F direction from a
3-option compass. Evaluate: F arrow hidden; student rotates a
candidate F arrow to correct direction blind. Wrinkle: right-hand
rule is the pedagogical target — direction, not magnitude, is graded.
